Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

APPENDIX A 

DEFINITIONS OF TERMS 

Main iL/ne — This is a simple running line oi the given specification and forms the main component 
of the gear to which snood and hooks are attached. 

Snood or Leader — This is a carbon steel wire of defmed length connecting the hook to the main 
line. This avoids direct contact of the fish with the main line, thus preventing damage to the main 
line by the fish. 

Swivel — This is an accessory to the gear, made of brass, oval in shape with eyes provided at both 
ends for attachment to the main line on the one side and snood on the other. This helps in 
revolving movement, thus preventing twisting or untwisting of the main line. 

Lure — This forms the extreme end of a troll line to which hooks are secured. These are intended 
to attract predatory fishes to the hooks shaped in such a manner as to simulate a fish in motion, 
while the gear is in operation.
